Yet their data and training remain closed, and open progress is held back by the quantity and quality of available data and by the pipelines and methods for producing it. Quality is the harder of the two, since a sample must be correct as a program, well built, and above all visually right once rendered. No existing signal covers all three. Execution often returns just a pass or fail, code similarity does not map to the visual output, and task-specific verifiers do not generalize. To push open progress further, we start from the data side with PrismaForge, a hierarchical data pipeline centered on a synthesized rubric that decomposes these factors into checkable criteria. The same rubric serves as both filter and reward: it curates the supervised corpus, then drives reinforcement learning on visual-coding tasks. Leveraging PrismaForge for data synthesis and filtering, we build PrismaCoder-2M, the most diverse open dataset for multimodal code intelligence and the largest to date. On the model side, we train PrismaCoder-9B and PrismaCoder-35B on this data and release both. They lead the open state of the art by a wide margin and rival leading proprietary systems. Our analyses further show that the proposed rubric-based pipeline improves multimodal coding performance across model backbones. We release our code and data at https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/.
arxiv.titleZh: PrismaCoder:以分解式评分准则合成推进开放多模态代码智能的边界
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对多模态代码智能(由文字或截图生成图表、网页、动画等可交互产物)中开源数据与训练方法落后的现状，提出分层数据流水线 PrismaForge:把「程序正确、构建良好、渲染后视觉正确」拆解为可核查的合成 rubric，同一套 rubric 既用于筛选监督数据，又充当强化学习的奖励信号。据此构建了规模最大、最多样的开源数据集 PrismaCoder-2M，并训练开源的 PrismaCoder-9B 与 PrismaCoder-35B，大幅刷新开源最优成绩并逼近头部闭源系统。分析显示该 rubric 流水线在不同骨干模型上均能提升多模态编码性能，为视觉到代码的生成与 RL 训练提供了可复用的数据与奖励范式。
arxiv.reason: 多模态代码智能，合成 rubric 兼作过滤与 RL 奖励，数据与模型全开源

arxiv.title: Revisiting Simple Baselines for Relational Deep Learning
arxiv.abstract: Relational deep learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning end-to-end predictive models over relational databases by representing them as temporal heterogeneous graphs. Recent advances based on graph neural networks and Transformers have achieved strong performance across diverse domains. However, the effectiveness of simpler relational baselines remains underexplored, making it difficult to assess how much architectural complexity is needed to achieve strong predictive performance. Motivated by the observation that predictive signals arise from target attributes, relational attributes, and historical labels, we revisit how effectively these signals can be exploited using simple propagation methods. We adapt fixed low-pass feature propagation to relational entity graphs and train an MLP for prediction. The resulting predictions are further refined using Correct-and-Smooth, a graph-based label propagation algorithm that incorporates historical labels over task-specific meta-graphs connecting target entities. Across classification and regression tasks on RelBench, an MLP trained on neighborhood-filtered features outperforms one using only target-entity features on most tasks and recovers a substantial portion of the performance of heterogeneous GNNs. Correct-and-Smooth provides further gains from historical labels, although applying it requires a separately constructed meta-graph because connections among target entities are not directly specified by the relational entity graph. Together, our studies revisit the effectiveness of established propagation methods as simple RDL baselines while identifying canonical meta-graph construction as a key challenge for effective label propagation.
arxiv.titleZh: 重新审视关系型深度学习的简单基线
arxiv.summaryZh: 关系数据库上的端到端预测近年多依赖异质 GNN 与 Transformer，但简单基线能达到什么水平缺乏系统对照。该工作把固定低通特征传播适配到关系实体图并用 MLP 预测，再用 Correct-and-Smooth 在连接目标实体的任务元图上做标签传播。在 RelBench 的分类与回归任务上，使用邻域过滤特征的 MLP 在多数任务上优于仅用目标实体特征的版本，并恢复到异质 GNN 相当一部分性能，标签传播借助历史标签进一步带来增益，但需单独构建元图。
arxiv.reason: 关系型图深度学习基线研究，与 LLM 关注方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization
arxiv.abstract: We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling. Our objective supervises a representation loss by factorizing the pointwise mutual information of the data, which we estimate by taking information differences between conditional predictions from a learned generative model. We justify our algorithm theoretically and empirically, demonstrating that our generative approach to representation learning avoids dimensional collapse and feature suppression in cases where commonly used methods like DINO and LeJEPA fail. Moreover, we show our representation learning technique is scalable; expending more compute leads to predictably better latent tokenization. For the first time, we perform a careful analysis of the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model and demonstrate that our approach is a compute-optimal improvement over direct diffusion for pixel-space generation, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 with JiT-L. Applied to ImageNet and the text-to-image dataset GPIC, we show tokenizer encoder scaling laws for diffusability, where extrapolating our approach achieves representations in 7x fewer FLOPs than DINOv2 on ImageNet and 8x fewer FLOPs than WebSSL on GPIC.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向可扩展潜空间分词化的生成式表示学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对扩散模型在像素空间生成算力开销大的问题，提出一种自监督表示学习目标:通过分解数据逐点互信息来监督表示损失，互信息由生成模型条件预测之间的信息差估计。该方法在 DINO、LeJEPA 失效的场景下避免了维度坍缩与特征抑制，并呈现可扩展性——算力增加带来可预测的潜空间分词质量提升。首次联合分析分词器与生成模型的 FLOP 效率，在 ImageNet 上以 JiT-L 取得 FID-50K 2.18，外推后比 DINOv2 省 7 倍 FLOPs，在 GPIC 上比 WebSSL 省 8 倍。
arxiv.reason: 面向扩散生成的图像 tokenizer，属图像生成低分方向

arxiv.title: ActiveEvidence: Decision-Focused Evidence Graphs with Verifiable Acquisition Gaps
arxiv.abstract: A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an $ε$-decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. The certificate is model-relative: it verifies policy-consistent optimality under the pinned learned score, and semantic quality is measured separately through post-freeze labels. Paired continuation rollouts learn the downstream value of paid previews, an online operational cost filter is separated from independent finite-policy-family trajectory certification, and an acquisition monitor with an independently implemented verifier binds every certificate to the frozen trace. On 640 cases split into 384/128/128 training, validation, and test cases, the controller reaches task score 0.842, grounding F1 0.816, evidence recall 0.873, 1.74 accepted calls, 286.5K visual tokens, and 742ms p95 latency. Dense replay of issued certificates shows 0.992 action agreement and a 0.988 certificate rate while evaluating 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms per decision.
arxiv.titleZh: ActiveEvidence:以决策为中心的证据图与可验证的获取缺口
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对多模态 agent 在免费元数据与付费观测的边界下，判断视觉证据是否值得获取、查询哪个候选、何时停止交互的问题，将其形式化为可决策认证的主动证据获取。反事实证据交互图(CEIG)编码一元证据价值、带符号二阶交互与有向条件危害并维护显式分数包络，决策加权目标收紧可能改变动作身份的界，缺口引导细化只评估能改变当前选择的交互，直至 ε-决策证书证明未解项无法改变所选动作。在 640 个案例上任务分 0.842、grounding F1 0.816、证据召回 0.873，平均 1.74 次接受调用、286.5K 视觉 token、p95 延迟 742ms，密集回放动作一致率 0.992，每决策仅评估 19.6 而非 191.4 个交互项。
arxiv.reason: Agent 证据获取决策加可验证证书，方向相关但场景偏细分

arxiv.title: The Physics Is the Network: Fast, Training-Free Neural Emulation
arxiv.abstract: Neural emulation need not require learning a substitute for known physics. We investigate PolyNets that couple a continuous-time neural representation of polynomial dynamics with a simple recurrent network for discrete-time integration. When the governing coefficients are known, the resulting tensor graph requires no training and preserves the prescribed numerical scheme while enabling efficient hardware execution and parallel simulation. Using the one-dimensional Korteweg-de Vries equation, we compare PolyNet with CPU and GPU finite-difference Runge-Kutta solvers and three trained neural models: a state-map emulator, a physics-informed predictor, and a learned-tendency integrator. Analytical soliton solutions provide a reference for amplitude and phase errors across grid resolutions, 10^6 dispersively scaled time steps, ensembles of up to 10^4 trajectories, and varying initial amplitudes. PolyNet achieves accuracy comparable to the numerical solvers, including at amplitudes outside the learned models' training conditions. It combines this fidelity with high GPU throughput, approximately constant over the tested resolution range, and favorable ensemble scaling.
arxiv.titleZh: 物理即网络:快速、免训练的神经仿真
arxiv.summaryZh: 神经仿真未必需要学习已知物理的替代模型。PolyNet 将多项式动力学的连续时间神经表示与一个简单循环网络耦合用于离散时间积分，在控制系数已知时构成免训练的 tensor graph，既保持给定数值格式，又便于硬件并行执行。在一维 Korteweg-de Vries 方程上，它与 CPU/GPU 有限差分 Runge-Kutta 求解器精度相当，在训练条件之外的振幅上仍保持精度，并具备跨分辨率近似恒定的 GPU 吞吐与良好的集合扩展性。
arxiv.reason: 物理 PDE 神经仿真，与 LLM 方向基本无关

arxiv.title: The Wealth of Agents: Scaling Agentic AI Across Developers
arxiv.abstract: Today's agentic systems are typically designed, built, and deployed by single developers with full control over all participating agents. While this simplifies development, it limits the potential scale of agentic systems. We study multi-developer agentic systems (MDAs) which enable developers to collaboratively build agentic systems to push frontier capability beyond what any individual developer could achieve alone. We construct empirical and theoretical models of developers to compare MDAs with single-developer agentic systems (SDAs). On GAIA, a general assistant benchmark, a population of specialized developers whose individual agents do not exceed 35% accuracy reaches 70% when their agents are combined in an MDA. This MDA performs 12 percentage points above the median general-purpose SDA built with several times each specialist's development budget. Our theoretical models show how MDAs can incentivize specialization and encourage more efficient use of aggregated developer resources. Put together, our results make a preliminary case for MDAs as a new scaling axis by enabling developers with diverse capabilities and resources to advance agentic AI collaboratively.
arxiv.titleZh: 智能体的财富：跨开发者扩展智能体 AI
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对当前智能体系统多由单一开发者独立构建、规模受限的问题，提出多开发者智能体系统（MDA），让不同开发者协同构建智能体。作者建立开发者经验与理论模型，在通用助手基准 GAIA 上，个体准确率均不超 35% 的专精开发者群体通过 MDA 组合后达到 70%，比用数倍于单个专家开发预算构建的通用型单开发者系统（SDA）中位数高 12 个百分点。理论模型显示 MDA 能激励专业化分工并更高效利用聚合的开发资源，为把多开发者协作视作智能体能力扩展的新维度提供了初步依据。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体协作与扩展新范式，GAIA 上有明确增益

arxiv.title: VASPO: Self-Distillation with Privileged Value Estimation
arxiv.abstract: On-policy self-distillation provides dense supervision for reasoning models via a privileged self-teacher. However, this supervision reflects local token preferences rather than the expected return of an unguided student continuation. Recent methods combine this signal with GRPO. They use GRPO for update directions and the teacher for signal scaling. However, we demonstrate a more effective integration within PPO. Specifically, we identify complementary positional dynamics: privileged information enhances a critic's value-prediction accuracy toward the response's end, whereas self-teacher guidance is strong initially, drops mid-generation, and rebounds finally. These insights motivate Value-Augmented Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (VASPO), wherein a self-teacher and critic evaluate identical privileged information at student-generated prefixes. The critic computes token-level PPO advantages from predicted continuation returns, while the self-teacher modulates selected positive advantages via bounded probability ratios. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, VASPO improves mean accuracy over PPO by 2.59 and 1.81 percentage points on Qwen3-4B and OLMo3-7B variants, respectively, and achieves the highest mean accuracy among evaluated methods on Knights and Knaves. Our code is available at https://github.com/cii030/VASPO.
arxiv.titleZh: VASPO: 基于特权价值估计的自蒸馏
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对在线策略自蒸馏中特权的自教师信号只反映局部 token 偏好、而非学生无引导续写的期望回报这一问题，该工作把自教师与 critic 结合进 PPO 框架:二者在同一学生生成前缀上评估相同的特权信息，critic 由预测的续写回报计算 token 级 PPO 优势，自教师则通过有界概率比调节被选中的正优势。作者还刻画了两者的互补位置动态——特权信息在回答后段提升 critic 的价值预测精度，而自教师引导前期强、中期衰减、末期回升。在六个数学推理基准上，Qwen3-4B 与 OLMo3-7B 版本相对 PPO 平均准确率分别提升 2.59 与 1.81 个百分点，并在 Knights and Knaves 上取得所评估方法中的最高平均准确率。
arxiv.reason: PPO 内融合特权自蒸馏与 critic，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Bayesian Learning to Select Fair Classifiers
arxiv.abstract: Evaluations of classifiers (AI or human or agents) often assume a batch setting in which every agent produces labels on every example in a test set, which can be expensive or impractical in many contexts. This motivates online policies that adaptively select agents to query as examples arrive and update policies as outcomes are observed. We study the problem of selecting, in an online stream, the agent that best balances (i) predictive performance and (ii) subgroup fairness of a sensitive attribute, and that allows for delayed observations of true class labels. We formulate this as a Bayesian multi-armed bandit problem using Thompson Sampling, explicitly balancing accuracy and fairness. We conduct empirical evaluations on real-world datasets spanning problems involving tabular classifiers, large language models, and human labelers, demonstrating substantial reductions in regret relative to baselines. Our theoretical contributions include guarantees on the performance of the selected agent that incorporate both the accuracy and fairness aspects of the problem.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向公平分类器选择的贝叶斯学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 在线场景中往往无法对每个样本都查询全部标注者，该工作把「在样本流中挑选能在预测性能与敏感属性子群公平性之间取得最佳平衡的智能体」建模为贝叶斯多臂老虎机问题，用 Thompson Sampling 在真实类别标签延迟到达的条件下持续更新选择策略，并给出同时涵盖准确率与公平性的性能保证。在表格分类器、大语言模型与人类标注者三类真实数据集上的实验显示，其 regret 相比基线显著降低。
arxiv.reason: 老虎机+公平性选标注者，仅擦边 LLM 与 Agent，方向偏离

arxiv.title: A Two-Level Clinical Novelty Prioritization Framework for Disease Trajectories Discovered from Longitudinal Electronic Health Records
arxiv.abstract: Graph-based analysis of electronic health records (EHRs) yields disease-trajectory catalogs, but structural support does not establish semantic novelty. We present a two-level framework to prioritize 99,527 branching motifs previously discovered by an upstream patient-disjoint, train-only MIMIC-IV v3.1 pipeline and frozen after validation-based catalog selection. The framework separates path-level and node-to-endpoint semantic sparsity from reliability-adjusted clinical priority. Three deterministic textualizations per motif or node-target pair were embedded with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 and calibrated against 166,972 pre-2023 PubMed references using mean top-20 cosine distance. Positive recombination occurred in 8.63% of motifs and had negligible effect on global ranking, whereas specificity and support/GNN reliability terms changed clinical-priority ordering. Robustness analyses across neighbor counts, templates, encoders, generic-label taxonomies, score settings, PrimeKG, and corrected density-based RND showed that broad ordering was more stable than hard top-k membership. A semantic-dose analysis did not support a monotonic relation between score and forecasting benefit after endpoint and token-count adjustment (1.96 days per SD; 95% CI, -0.75 to 4.68). In the frozen catalog-q90 high-semantic subgroup, branch-enhanced forecasting reduced conditional event-time MAE by 20.1 days (95% CI, 13.3-27.0) and sMAPE by 2.37 percentage points (95% CI, 1.81-2.93), while discrimination and endpoint-ranking differences were inconclusive. Corrected RND showed low tail agreement with the primary score (Spearman rho = 0.430; q90 Jaccard = 0.125) despite a similar aggregate timing association. These findings support representation-aware, uncertainty-aware literature-relative prioritization of discovered trajectories rather than causal discovery or clinician-adjudicated novelty.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向纵向电子健康记录中发现的疾病轨迹的两级临床新颖性优先级排序框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对电子健康记录图谱挖掘出的疾病轨迹目录，结构支持度无法反映语义新颖性。该工作提出两级框架对99,527个分支motif排序：用BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5嵌入每个motif或节点-终点对的三种文本化表示，与166,972篇2023年前PubMed文献按top-20平均余弦距离校准，得到路径级与节点到终点的语义稀疏度，再分离出可靠性调整的临床优先级。稳健性分析显示整体排序比硬性top-k更稳定；语义剂量与预测收益无单调关系，q90高语义子组中分支增强预测使条件事件时间MAE降低20.1天、sMAPE降低2.37个百分点。结果支持表示感知、不确定性感知的文献相对排序，而非因果发现。
arxiv.reason: EHR疾病轨迹的临床新颖性排序，属医疗垂直应用，与LLM方向无关

arxiv.title: ReaDy: Recurrent States as Dynamic Context for Speculative Drafting in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average $3.16\times$ decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.
arxiv.titleZh: ReaDy:以循环状态作为动态上下文，为混合线性注意力大语言模型的投机草稿生成服务
arxiv.summaryZh: 基于特征的投机解码草稿器依赖目标模型的隐藏特征，其上下文侧重未必匹配后续草稿位置的需求。ReaDy首次利用混合线性注意力(HLA)模型累积历史关联的紧凑循环状态，为每个草稿位置配备可学习query，从目标已提交的循环状态中检索位置专属的补充上下文，再由轻量state reader以残差方式注入草稿表示，并以低秩状态读取与融合算子压低算力与I/O开销;整体基于DSpark的并行骨干与顺序预测头，采用两阶段轻量适配。在数学、代码生成与对话共七个基准上，单张NVIDIA B200 GPU上对Qwen3.8-27B平均取得3.16倍解码加速，吞吐与接受长度较DSpark分别提升7.97%与8.50%。
arxiv.reason: 投机解码结合线性注意力循环状态，系统与效率方向扎实

arxiv.title: Graph-Enhanced Disease Trajectory Discovery and Temporal Endpoint Forecasting from Longitudinal Electronic Health Records
arxiv.abstract: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can reveal disease-progression structure, while useful forecasting requires leakage-controlled discovery, censor-aware outcomes, and inspectable trajectory evidence. We developed a graph-enhanced framework in MIMIC-IV v3.1 that splits patients before graph construction, learns train-only consecutive-admission transitions, and freezes endpoint-specific branching-motif policies selected on validation data. The final catalog contained 99,527 motifs, and a time-aware Transformer retrieved at most 24 patient-compatible motifs per endpoint through endpoint-specific cross-attention. Across five training seeds, micro-AUPRC increased from 0.9330 to 0.9357, while event-time MAE decreased from 676.9 to 657.7 days (reduction 19.2 days; 95% paired patient-cluster bootstrap CI, 13.8-24.8). Timing effects were heterogeneous: MAE worsened for events within 730 days but improved by 58.9 days for events occurring after 730 days. In an exploratory internal temporal split, branch conditioning reduced conditional event-time MAE by 26.9 days (95% CI, 23.0-30.8) without evidence of better micro-AUPRC. Corrected survival evaluation over the supported 0-2,555-day interval did not establish macro C-index or integrated Brier score superiority over a matched history-only discrete-hazard model. A directed, degree-matched GNN repair substantially improved unseen-edge discovery, yet replacing GNN-derived scores within fixed motif identities did not improve downstream forecasting. These results position branching motifs as structured trajectory context whose main value is long-range timing support rather than uniformly stronger endpoint discrimination, survival prediction, or causal explanation.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于图增强的纵向电子健康记录疾病轨迹发现与时间终点预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对纵向电子健康记录中疾病进展建模易泄漏、结局需处理删失、轨迹证据需可检视的问题，构建了一套图增强框架:先在 MIMIC-IV v3.1 上按患者切分再建图，仅用训练集学习连续入院转移，并在验证集上冻结终点专属的分支模体策略，最终得到 99,527 个模体，再由时间感知 Transformer 通过终点专属交叉注意力为每个终点检索至多 24 个患者兼容模体。五个训练种子下 micro-AUPRC 由 0.9330 升至 0.9357，事件时间 MAE 由 676.9 天降至 657.7 天(减少 19.2 天，95% 置信区间 13.8–24.8);但校正后的生存评估未能在 macro C-index 与积分 Brier 分数上超过匹配的仅用病史离散风险模型，且 GNN 派生分数并未改善下游预测。结果表明分支模体的主要价值在于长程时间预测支持，而非一致的终点判别、生存预测或因果解释能力。
arxiv.reason: 医疗 EHR 疾病轨迹预测，属生物医药垂直应用

arxiv.title: Hindsight-Privileged RLVR: Single-Rollout Token Credit Without Group Sampling
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains language models from checked task outcomes, but assigning a terminal reward to individual reasoning tokens or actions remains difficult. Group-relative methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) sample several attempts per prompt, but lose their reward-based learning signal when all attempts receive the same outcome. We propose Hindsight-Privileged RLVR (HP-RLVR), a single-rollout method that turns a completed trajectory's own future into token-level update weights. The generating policy snapshot scores each eligible token under its causal history and under a hindsight context containing the realized future and verifier feedback. A normalized Jensen--Shannon divergence between the two views weights the reward relative to a historical baseline, yielding bounded token credit for both successful and failed attempts, with no reference solution or learned critic. In paired Qwen3-8B runs over a shared $100$-step schedule, HP-RLVR trains $1.21\times$, $1.46\times$, and $2.30\times$ faster than GRPO on mathematics, code generation, and ALFWorld, using one eighth the rollouts per prompt. Accuracy is comparable overall, with HP-RLVR ahead on mathematics at all three sizes and GRPO ahead on code and ALFWorld. In ALFWorld, $43.2\%$ (4B) and $49.0\%$ (8B) of GRPO's gradient-norm records are zero, versus none for HP-RLVR.
arxiv.titleZh: 后见特权 RLVR:无需组采样的单 rollout token 信用分配
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 RLVR 中终端奖励难以分配到单个推理 token、且 GRPO 等组相对方法在组内结果全同(全对或全错)时奖励信号归零的问题，提出单 rollout 的 HP-RLVR:让生成策略快照分别在因果历史与含已实现未来及验证器反馈的「后见」上下文下为每个 token 打分，以两个分布的归一化 Jensen-Shannon 散度作为相对历史基线的权重，给出有界 token credit，无需参考解或 critic。在 Qwen3-8B 的同一 100 步计划下，数学、代码生成、ALFWorld 的训练速度分别为 GRPO 的 1.21×、1.46×、2.30×，每 prompt rollout 数仅为其八分之一;总体准确率相当，数学在三档规模上均领先，代码与 ALFWorld 略逊。ALFWorld 中 GRPO 有 43.2%(4B)与 49.0%(8B)的梯度范数记录为零，HP-RLVR 则没有。
arxiv.reason: RLVR 单 rollout 的 token 级信用分配，直击 GRPO 组内同结果失效

arxiv.title: Average-Reward Policy Identification from a Single Continuing Trajectory
arxiv.abstract: In reinforcement learning, an agent must explore an unknown environment to learn how to make good decisions. Unlike methods that can freely sample any state--action pair, an agent learning from a single trajectory must spend additional time navigating between states. It is therefore natural to expect that learning from a single trajectory requires more experience. In this paper, we show that this additional cost is not always necessary. For average-reward reinforcement learning, we develop an algorithm that learns where to collect information while ensuring that the required samples can be obtained efficiently. We establish an upper bound on the number of interactions needed to identify a near-optimal policy. Furthermore, we prove a matching information theoretic lower bound, showing that, for a broad class of environments and at sufficiently high accuracy, learning from a single trajectory is no harder in the worst case than learning with unrestricted access to state action samples. Our results reveal that the additional complexity cost of navigation can be avoided by adapting information gathering requirements to how the environment provides information.
arxiv.titleZh: 从单条持续轨迹中识别平均奖励近最优策略
arxiv.summaryZh: 在平均奖励强化学习中，智能体只能沿单条持续轨迹与环境交互，在状态间移动会带来额外的探索开销，通常被认为需要更多样本。该工作设计了一种自适应决定在何处采集信息的算法，保证所需样本可高效获得，给出识别近最优策略所需交互次数的上界，并证明与之匹配的信息论下界。结果表明，对一大类环境且在精度足够高时，单轨迹学习的最坏情况难度与可自由采样状态-动作对的情形相同，即导航开销可通过让信息采集方式适配环境的信息提供方式来消除。
arxiv.reason: 纯 RL 理论学习，单轨迹样本复杂度，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Decoupled Marginal Sharpening for Training-Free Inference-Time Scaling
arxiv.abstract: We study how to improve LLM reasoning at inference time without updating model weights or using external reward models. Recent reward-free power-sampling methods define the sequence-level power target $π_α(y\mid x)\propto p_0(y\mid x)^α$, where $α>1$, which increases the relative probability of completions that are already likely under the base model. Existing methods use Metropolis--Hastings or Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to approximately sample from this target. However, two challenges arise at different levels. At the target level, full-sequence sharpening can concentrate probability on a few exact reasoning--answer trajectories, suppressing alternative paths that support the same answer. At the sampler level, finite-particle SMC can suffer from path collapse when resampling repeatedly duplicates a few high-weight prefixes. To address these challenges, we propose Decoupled Marginal Sharpening (DMS), which separately controls how strongly the model favors particular reasoning paths and how strongly it favors final answers after aggregating support across those paths. At the target level, DMS first samples from a sharpened reasoning distribution, then marginalizes the model's answer probabilities over the resulting weighted reasoning population and sharpens the induced answer marginal. Separate exponents allow mild reasoning sharpening to encourage exploration of diverse paths, followed by stronger answer-marginal sharpening to concentrate probability on answers with greater aggregate support across those paths. At the sampler level, we develop Fully Adapted Annealed SMC, which combines an annealed sequence of power targets with locally fully adapted proposals and predictive ancestor resampling. Experiments on MATH500, GPQA-Diamond, HumanEval, and AIME24/25 across three base models show that DMS achieves the highest mean pass@1 among the compared methods in all tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: 用于免训练推理时扩展的解耦边缘锐化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对免训练、无外部奖励模型的推理时扩展，现有 reward-free power sampling 对整条序列做幂次锐化来逼近目标分布，但序列级锐化会把概率集中到少数精确推理-答案轨迹，抑制支撑同一答案的其他路径，有限粒子 SMC 反复重采样也易路径坍缩。DMS 把「偏好特定推理路径」与「聚合各路径支撑后偏好最终答案」解耦:先在锐化的推理分布上采样，再对加权推理群体诱导的答案边缘分布施加更强锐化，并配合 Fully Adapted Annealed SMC(退火幂目标 + 局部完全自适应提议 + 预测性祖先重采样)。在 MATH500、GPQA-Diamond、HumanEval、AIME24/25 与三种基座模型上，平均 pass@1 均高于对比方法。
arxiv.reason: 推理时扩展的目标分布与采样器设计，直接命中 test-time scaling

arxiv.title: Lost in Translation: Why Lower Bias Scores Don't Mean Fairer Models
arxiv.abstract: Bias audits of multilingual language models usually compare a model's average stereotype score in English with its average in another language and read the difference as a difference in fairness. We ask how much of that difference is noise. Auditing ten open models in eight languages, we measure how far scores move when English test items are merely reworded, test every language shift item by item, and check that the test catches shifts we inject on purpose. In all 70 model-language pairs the stereotype score falls below its English level, and for Hindi, Korean and Swahili the drop clearly exceeds what rewording English produces; most of it comes from StereoSet items. Judging every translation, we find that imperfect ones drop more, but faithful translations alone drop nearly as much. Still, a lower average does not show that a model is fairer. An item's English score predicts its translated score far less well than its reworded score (correlation 0.23, 0.27 on faithful translations, vs. 0.48), while scores stay as far from neutral, models agree on translated items, and within Hindi or Spanish a translated item's score correlates with its own rewording at 0.84 and 0.82. The average cannot distinguish lower bias from a different pattern of item-level scores. We also document three common pipeline errors that silently erase bias signal, and release our code.
arxiv.titleZh: 迷失于翻译:为何更低的偏见分数不代表更公平的模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 多语言偏见审计常把英语与其他语言的平均刻板印象分数之差直接读作公平性差异，这篇工作追问其中有多少是噪声。在 10 个开放模型、8 种语言上，测量仅改写英语测试项带来的分数漂移，逐条目检验语言切换，并注入已知偏移验证测试灵敏度。70 个模型-语言对的刻板印象分数全部低于英语，印地语、韩语、斯瓦希里语的降幅明显超过英语改写效应。但条目英语分数对翻译分数的预测力(相关 0.23)远低于改写版本(0.48)，分数仍远离中性，翻译条目与自身改写的相关达 0.84/0.82，平均值无法区分偏见更低与条目级模式不同，跨语言公平性比较需转向条目级分析。
arxiv.reason: 多语言偏见评测的可靠性拆解，属评测方法学扎实工作

arxiv.title: AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
arxiv.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) often fail midway through unseen long-horizon tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a remedy, but embodied RSI methods either refine the harness around a frozen executor and so cannot add a missing motion, or train the executor on persistent failures without asking whether a failure lies in how the executor is called or in what it can do. We ask when a self-improving embodied system should change the weights of its executor, and propose AdaRSI, an on-demand RSI framework for embodied agents. A coding agent first improves its skills and harness, then attributes persistent failures by retrying failing sub-steps from saved states, and fine-tunes only the sub-steps that remain unreliable, with demonstrations it collects itself and experience carried over from earlier tasks. On all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365, with GR00T N1.5 as the executor and no human demonstrations, AdaRSI improves the VLA on all three suites and raises its success on unseen composite tasks from 4.6% to 13.8%. Compared with fine-tuning every sub-step, it reaches slightly higher success while using only 28% of the GPU time and 22% of the self-collected demonstrations, and fine-tuning without a harness trains more yet gains far less.
arxiv.titleZh: AdaRSI:面向具身智能体的按需递归自我改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 预训练 VLA 在未见的长时程任务中常在途中失败，而现有的具身递归自我改进要么只优化冻结执行器外围的 harness、无法补上缺失动作，要么对持续失败盲目全量微调，不区分失败源于调用方式还是能力不足。AdaRSI 让编码智能体先提升自身技能与 harness，再从保存的状态重试失败子步骤做失败归因，仅对仍不可靠的子步骤用自行采集的演示与跨任务经验做微调。在 RoboCasa365 全部 50 个目标任务上，以 GR00T N1.5 为执行器且不使用人类演示，三个 suite 均获提升，未见复合任务成功率由 4.6% 升至 13.8%，同时只耗全子步骤微调 28% 的 GPU 时间与 22% 的自采集演示。其按需微调与失败归因思路对具身智能体的自进化与 harness 设计有参考价值。
arxiv.reason: VLA 具身智能体自改进，属机器人方向，画像明确低分

arxiv.title: SafeAdapt-Poker: Counterfactual Risk Calibration for Budgeted Adaptation under Opponent Shift
arxiv.abstract: Opponent histories can mislead after behavioral shifts. SafeAdapt-Poker formulates budgeted adaptation under opponent shift as a dual-counterfactual sequential-control problem using only information available before each decision. At each decision the controller asks two distinct questions: what local downside a deviation from the frozen anchor would induce under matched legal continuations, and what future adaptation value would be lost by consuming part of the remaining deviation budget now. The first question is answered by a monotone strategic-risk model over deviation intensity; the second by a paired budget-state continuation model that prices current budget consumption. The controller selects among support-preserving candidate deviations by trading immediate adaptation value against these two quantities, a pathwise cumulative-KL ledger bounds total anchor-relative deviation, and a finite family of frozen controllers is screened on complete paired calibration sessions before held-out interaction. A finite-candidate perturbation bound shows that the allocation objective degrades continuously with continuation-value estimation error. Evaluation covers exact-game exploitation and safety, four opponent shifts, local-risk calibration, delayed-opportunity allocation, direct opportunity-value estimation, value-error robustness, factorial mechanism attribution, budget sensitivity, abstract-HUNL cross-play, and player/time-held-out public-history behavior. On exact Leduc the full controller attains a matched weak-pool gain of +0.0718 with a worst-opponent delta of -0.0126, raises delayed-opportunity capture from 0.6318 under myopic allocation to 0.7841 under the same session budget, and reaches +42.7 mbb/hand in abstract-HUNL cross-play; the retained public-history screen reports 0.5820 action accuracy and 0.9277 log loss versus 0.5039 and 0.9778 for a public prior.
arxiv.titleZh: SafeAdapt-Poker:对手策略漂移下预算受限自适应的反事实风险校准
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对对手历史在行为漂移后失效的问题，把预算受限自适应建模为双反事实序列控制，仅用每次决策前可得的信息。控制器同时回答两问:偏离冻结锚点在匹配合法续局下的局部下行风险(由偏离强度的单调策略风险模型给出)，以及当前消耗预算会损失多少未来自适应价值(由配对预算状态延续模型定价)，并以路径累积 KL 账本约束相对锚点的总偏离，在完整配对校准会话上先筛选有限个冻结控制器。在精确 Leduc 上取得 +0.0718 的弱池收益、最差对手 -0.0126，延迟机会捕获由近视分配的 0.6318 升至 0.7841;抽象 HUNL 交叉对局达 +42.7 mbb/hand，公开历史筛选下动作准确率 0.5820、log loss 0.9277。
arxiv.reason: 扑克博弈中的对手建模与预算控制，与 LLM 关注方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: ChronoCulture: Evaluating Cultural Awareness Across Time in Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Cultural attitudes and social norms evolve over time, yet most cultural benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) treat culture as a static attribute of a country or region. We introduce ChronoCulture, a benchmark of 10,360 temporal pairs built from longitudinal survey data across 72 countries. Each pair contains the same survey question asked in the same country in an older and a newer year, with full population response distributions as ground truth. Across six LLMs, we find that models can often predict a country's attitudes at one point in time but do not reliably capture how those attitudes change. Their predictions for different years tend to stay close together, failing to capture much of the observed change. Specifying the intended year in the prompt also offers little overall improvement in alignment with survey responses. These findings suggest that models often present a largely static picture of cultural attitudes, highlighting the need to evaluate cultural awareness across time.
arxiv.titleZh: ChronoCulture:评估大语言模型跨时间的文化意识
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有文化类benchmark多把文化视为国家或地区的静态属性，忽略态度与规范随时间演变。ChronoCulture基于72个国家的纵向调查数据构建10360个时间配对，每对为同一国家、同一问题在较早与较晚年份的作答，并以完整人口响应分布作为真值。对六个LLM的评测显示，模型常能预测某一时点的国家态度，却无法可靠刻画态度如何变化，不同年份的预测彼此接近，提示词中指定年份也几乎无助于提升与调查分布的对齐。该工作表明模型呈现的文化图景高度静态，为跨时间的文化意识评测提供了可复用的数据与指标。
arxiv.reason: 文化类benchmark，属评测与方法学方向，但主题偏垂直

arxiv.title: Selective Growing Q-Networks (SGQN): An Analysis of Adaptive Action Grids in Decoupled Q-Learning
arxiv.abstract: Value-based Q-learning for continuous control can discretise the action space, but the resolution of the discretisation trades early exploration against final precision. Growing Q-Networks (GQN) grow the resolution uniformly from coarse to fine. We introduce Selective Growing Q-Networks (SGQN), which keeps decoupled Q-learning and replaces uniform growth with an adaptive action grid: bins are added next to bins with high estimated Q-value, bins with low Q-value are pruned, and actions are chosen epsilon-greedily. On eight DeepMind Control Suite (DMControl) tasks with 2 to 12 action dimensions, SGQN has the highest mean final return among the compared methods on four, is within 1.1% of the best method on three more, and is 3.4% below Bang-Bang MPO on Walker Run, using on average 7.5 of 9 available bins per dimension. We then test whether the adaptive grid explains these results, and find that it does not. Growth activates every candidate bin and behaves like uniform growth, and removing pruning changes the return by at most 1.1%. Two other choices matter: starting from a coarse grid, since starting with all 9 bins produces collapsed seeds, and epsilon-greedy selection, since an annealed softmax lowers the return by 23% to 100%. SGQN is insensitive to its growth and pruning hyperparameters. It also differs from the GQN and DecQN baselines in other respects, notably one gradient update per environment step instead of one per eight, which we did not control for, so we do not attribute its advantage to a single component. We present SGQN as a competitive value-based method and as an analysis of which ingredients of a growing action grid matter.
arxiv.comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Under review at TMLR
arxiv.titleZh: 选择性增长 Q 网络(SGQN):解耦 Q 学习中自适应动作网格的分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 连续控制中基于价值的 Q 学习可以把动作空间离散化，但离散分辨率需要在早期探索与最终精度之间权衡。SGQN 在解耦 Q 学习框架下用自适应动作网格替代 GQN 的均匀增长:在高估值 Q 的分箱旁新增分箱、剪除低估值分箱，并以 ε-greedy 选择动作。在 DeepMind Control Suite 的八项任务(动作维度 2 至 12)上，它在四项取得最高平均最终回报，三项与最优方法差距在 1.1% 以内，Walker Run 上低于 Bang-Bang MPO 3.4%，每维平均使用 9 个分箱中的 7.5 个。消融表明自适应网格并非收益来源——增长会激活全部候选分箱、表现等同均匀增长，移除剪枝带来的回报变化不超过 1.1%，真正起作用的是粗网格初始化与 ε-greedy 选择。
arxiv.reason: 经典控制 RL(DMControl)，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Learning by Examples: Power Grid Steady State Analysis with a Tabular Foundation Model
arxiv.abstract: Foundation models have shown strong generalization across scientific domains, but their use in power systems remains largely task-specific. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TFM), TabPFN, can serve as a general-purpose neural solver for power grid steady-state analysis. We evaluate the TFM on three tasks: power flow (PF) prediction, N-k contingency screening (NCS), and voltage stability margin (VSM) prediction. We performed experiments on 118- and 2000-bus systems, comparing the TFM against task-specific neural baselines. Without retraining or fine-tuning, the TFM matches or outperforms the best task-specific model in several settings across the three tasks. For 118-bus PF prediction, a variant of the TFM achieves errors of $1\times 10^{-3}$ pu for voltage magnitudes and $0.30^\circ$ for voltage angles, outperforming all baselines. On unseen N-1 contingency and close-to-infeasible PF cases, the TFM is competitive with the DCPF approximation. For millions of unseen N-2 contingencies, the TFM achieves AUCs of 0.92 and 0.95 for branch and voltage violation screening, respectively. The TFM also attains accurate VSM prediction performance for the 2000-bus system with limited labelled data. The TFM attains strong results across the tested tasks despite pretraining without any power-system-specific dataset and requiring no fine-tuning step. These results offer a glimpse into the potential of pretrained TFMs as a neural solver for a range of power grid analysis tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: 以示例学习:用表格基础模型做电网稳态分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 电网稳态分析目前多依赖任务专用模型，本文考察预训练表格基础模型 TabPFN 能否充当通用神经求解器，在潮流预测、N-k 故障筛选与电压稳定裕度预测三类任务上，与任务专用神经网络基线在 118 与 2000 节点系统上对比。无需再训练或微调，TabPFN 即能在多个设置中追平或超越最佳基线:118 节点潮流预测的电压幅值误差为 1×10⁻³ pu、相角误差 0.30°;在百万级未见过 N-2 故障上，支路与电压越限筛选 AUC 分别达 0.92 与 0.95;2000 节点系统在标注数据有限时仍能准确预测电压稳定裕度。结果提示预训练表格基础模型可作为覆盖多类电网分析任务的通用求解器，适用于标注稀缺的电力系统场景。
arxiv.reason: 电网稳态分析属能源垂直应用，TabPFN 非 LLM，落入低分方向

arxiv.title: Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR
arxiv.abstract: Character Error Rate (CER), the standard metric for OCR and vision-language models (VLMs), charges a typo as much as a wrong name. We introduce semCER, which keeps CER's alignment and denominator and charges each grapheme edit a severity from an LLM judge, with no word segmentation. Normalized CER keeps the score of a whole transcription, where it tracks readers as well as semCER or better, and semCER breaks that score down into named edits. The charges track readers' ratings edit by edit in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese and put the edits readers rate most severe near the top of a sorted list. On pairs drawn where CER and semCER disagreed, readers side with semCER more often than with normalized CER in English and Chinese, and equally often in Vietnamese. Across 16 languages, the judge charges a wrong diacritic or tone mark almost nothing in Spanish but nearly a wrong letter's severity in Telugu. Where we can count real words, a general VLM's wrong letter forms one far above chance while a classical pipeline's stays near it. We release the 61 million judged edits, the aggregated reader ratings, and the distilled scorer at https://github.com/nguyenx2t/semcer.
arxiv.comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Under review at ACL Rolling Review
arxiv.titleZh: 同等 CER，不同损伤：面向 OCR 的严重度加权字符错误率
arxiv.summaryZh: 标准 OCR 与 VLM 指标 CER 把错别字与错人名同等计罚，semCER 保留 CER 的对齐方式与分母，由 LLM judge 为每个字形编辑赋予严重度权重，且无需分词。归一化 CER 给出整段转写分数，semCER 则将其拆解为具名编辑；在英语、越南语、中文中评分逐条贴合人工读者判断，排序还能把最严重的编辑置于前列。在 CER 与 semCER 分歧的样本上，英语与中文读者更常支持 semCER。跨 16 种语言，judge 对西班牙语变音符号几乎不罚分，泰卢固语的声调符号却接近错一个字母。工作公开了 6100 万条已评判编辑、人工评分聚合结果与蒸馏打分器。
arxiv.reason: LLM judge 驱动的评测指标改进，属评估方法学，但聚焦 OCR

arxiv.title: MolLean: A Process-Verifiable Language for Chemical Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Chemical chain-of-thought can contain hallucinated structural and property claims. We thereby introduce MolLean, a process-verifiable language that grounds chemical reasoning in an explicit molecular state. A layered Lean-based kernel checks state transitions and assertions over molecular readouts, from primitive graph edits to compound transformations. Meanwhile, a typed witness protocol separates native structural checks from externally supplied measurements. We further introduce MolLean-MCP, a stateful tool interface that exposes these transitions, checks, and readouts during generation: the model receives feedback to decide its next action, and rejected actions leave the state unchanged. MolLean supports one-pass trace execution, whole-trace refinement, and interactive reasoning through MolLean-MCP. We evaluate these three modes with direct chain-of-thought on 8,800 matched examples across 12 tasks spanning molecular generation, editing, optimization, and reactions. With Qwen3.6-27B, whole-trace refinement outperforms direct chain-of-thought on all 12 tasks. MolLean-MCP complements whole-trace refinement with stepwise verification feedback, reaching better performance in reaction tasks. Together, these results highlight an executable foundation for chemical reasoning, in which explicit chemical commitments can be checked and revised rather than remaining solely in free-form explanations.
arxiv.titleZh: MolLean：面向化学推理的过程可验证语言
arxiv.summaryZh: 化学思维链常包含虚构的结构与性质断言。MolLean以显式分子状态为推理地基：分层Lean内核校验从基本图编辑到复合变换的状态转移与断言，带类型见证协议区分原生结构检查与外部测量；配套的MolLean-MCP是有状态工具接口，生成时暴露状态转移、检查与读数，模型据此获得反馈决定下一步，被拒动作不改变状态。在12个任务、8800条配对样本上，用Qwen3.6-27B做整轨迹精修在全部12个任务上优于直接思维链，MolLean-MCP在反应类任务上再进一步提升，为可检查、可修正的化学推理提供了可执行基础。
arxiv.reason: 过程可验证推理加MCP有状态工具接口，方法有价值但属化学垂直领域

arxiv.title: Same Claim, Different Interpretations: How LLM Agents Resolve Ambiguity in Scientific Claims
arxiv.abstract: Co-scientists and agentic scientific claim verifiers are increasingly used to assess claims across the sciences. Natural-language scientific claims, written for human experts, are often underspecified and so admit several defensible interpretations. Such verifiers usually pick one, often tacitly, and benchmarks score their verdicts against expert labels without recording the expert's interpretation or the verifier's in a comparable form. This leads to disagreements with expert labels that cannot be traced to the evidence or the interpretation, and to compute spent on unchecked interpretations. We introduce Claim Cards to make such interpretations explicit in the reasoning itself. A Claim Card records a verifier's interpretation as nine fields before evidence gathering, each marked stated, inferred, or default. To test whether an agent's interpretation can change its verdict, we ran a GPT-5.4 agent five times on each of 60 expert-labeled materials-science and biomedical claims with a card, without one, and with one card frozen across runs (900 runs). Over 40% of card fields were not marked stated, and a card added about a tenth to a run's GPT-5.4 tokens and time without measurably changing agreement with expert labels. The agent's own interpretations varied between runs, although within a claim this variation did not measurably track the verdict. A deliberate change to one field of the frozen card, however, making the quantifier universal or the threshold for support stricter, changed the verdict on about a third of the claims, against about one in seven expected by chance (p < 0.001 for each edit). On 24 materials-science claims run with computational tools, the stricter threshold also changed what the agent asked those tools to compute. We therefore argue that verdicts should be reported with their interpretations and that benchmarks could publish the interpretation behind each label.
arxiv.titleZh: 同一论断，不同解读:LLM Agent 如何消解科学论断中的歧义
arxiv.summaryZh: 科学论断验证智能体常隐含地选定一种解读，而 benchmark 只比对结论、不记录解读，导致分歧无法归因。为此提出 Claim Card:在证据收集前用九个字段显式记录验证者的解读，每个字段标注为 stated、inferred 或 default。在 60 条专家标注的材料科学与生物医学论断上以 GPT-5.4 agent 各跑 5 次(共 900 次)，卡片增加约一成 token 与时间，却未显著提升与专家标签的一致率;而定向修改冻结卡片的量词或支持阈值，可使约三分之一的结论翻转(随机预期约七分之一，p<0.001)。作者据此主张结论应连同解读一并报告，benchmark 也应公开每个标签背后的解读。
arxiv.reason: 科学论断验证智能体的解读歧义与评测可靠性，擦边 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: The COUNT: Counting N-grams Unlocks Scaling on Host Memory and Training-Free Adaptation
arxiv.abstract: The scaling relationship of compute and performance for language models (LMs) has been extensively studied; more recently, models are being designed to scale memory use, as well. In particular, adding embeddings for n-grams scales memory separately from compute use, because each pass only processes individual embedding rows, which are much smaller than the storage used for the whole embedding table. However, existing methods train embeddings from scratch, which needs expensive GPU memory for fast reading and writing. Meanwhile, the ordinary memory of the host system is cheap and underutilized by these training methods. To scale on host memory, we introduce COUNT (Counting Offline Unlocks N-gram Transformers), which builds n-gram embeddings without adding learned parameters by storing precomputed n-gram counts on host. We use the corpus frequencies to weight together the LM's own unembeddings of the next tokens most often following the current n-gram history. At a fixed compute budget, COUNT can be added as an additional input embedding for pretraining 1B-parameter LMs to improve validation loss as much as an LM with 57% more compute. If GPU memory is limited, using COUNT to let backbone parameters fill GPU memory gives better performance than splitting memory with additional learned n-gram embeddings. Beyond efficiency, COUNT allows switching in a different table of n-gram counts from a domain-specific corpus at inference time to adapt to a new task without any training.
arxiv.titleZh: COUNT：用 N-gram 计数解锁主机内存扩展与免训练适配
arxiv.summaryZh: N-gram 嵌入能让内存独立于计算扩展，但已有方法需从零训练嵌入表，读写要占用昂贵 GPU 显存，而廉价的主机内存大量闲置。COUNT 把预计算好的 n-gram 计数存在主机侧，不引入任何可学习参数：用语料频率对语言模型自身 unembedding 中「该 n-gram 历史后最常出现的下一 token」加权求和。固定算力下，为 1B 参数模型预训练加挂 COUNT 输入嵌入带来的验证损失改善，相当于算力增加 57%；显存受限时让主干参数占满 GPU 优于把显存分给可学习 n-gram 嵌入。推理时直接替换某个领域的计数表即可免训练适配新任务。
arxiv.reason: 命中 LLM 预训练与效率方向，内存扩展机制新颖且有免训练适配

arxiv.title: The Accuracy Well: Nonmonotone Accuracy Dynamics at Vanishing Initialization
arxiv.abstract: We study classification dynamics under small initialization and identify a pronounced non-monotone behavior of accuracy that we call the accuracy well: accuracy rises rapidly early in training, subsequently drops, and only much later recovers. We observe this phenomenon in deep linear networks, fully connected ReLU networks on MNIST, deep convolutional networks on CIFAR-10, and controlled synthetic tasks, across different losses and optimizers and in both training and test accuracy. We propose a three-stage explanation in terms of target-driven organization, a degeneracy bottleneck, and subsequent recruitment and recovery. We develop a rigorous theory of these dynamics for shallow and deep linear networks, showing in particular that high accuracy can emerge while the predictor and the change in loss remain asymptotically vanishing, before continued optimization causes accuracy to deteriorate. For a simple synthetic classification task, we prove an extreme instance in which accuracy asymptotically rises to 100%, collapses to 0, and later recovers permanently to 100%. Our results show that classification accuracy can reveal aspects of learning dynamics that are not captured by the training loss alone.
arxiv.titleZh: 准确率之井：初始化解趋于零时的非单调准确率动力学
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究小初始化下分类训练的准确率非单调现象：准确率早期快速上升，随后下降，很久之后才恢复，作者称之为「准确率之井」。该现象在深度线性网络、MNIST 全连接 ReLU 网络、CIFAR-10 深度卷积网络及合成任务中普遍出现，跨损失函数与优化器，训练与测试准确率均可见。作者提出「目标驱动组织—退化瓶颈—重新招募恢复」三阶段解释，并对浅层与深层线性网络给出严格理论，证明准确率可在预测器与损失变化渐近消失时仍然上升；在合成任务中构造出准确率渐近升至 100%、崩至 0、最终永久恢复到 100% 的极端例子。结果表明分类准确率能揭示训练损失无法反映的学习动力学。
arxiv.reason: 小初始化训练动力学理论分析，属训练稳定性边缘方向

arxiv.title: From Training to Escalation: Forensic Analysis and Local Recreation of RL/RLHF-Induced Privilege Escalation in AI Agents (CVE-2026-65616)
arxiv.abstract: Mid-2026 reporting on autonomous AI evaluation incidents claimed that frontier large language model (LLM) agents escaped server containment through emergent coordination and cloud infrastructure attacks. This paper contextualizes those claims through forensic analysis and containerized recreation of both the Highly Persistent Internal Model (HPIM) training-case conditions and the Phase One privilege escalation targeting internal package repositories during OpenAI's ExploitGym evaluations. We recreate the configuration of the OpenAI-provided training example and reproduce the cryptographic verification bypass (CVE-2026-65616) in isolated repository servers, where misconfigured systems enabled token forgery and privilege escalation through basic HTTP requests, Python, and JavaScript. Crucially, the training-example conditions and the Phase One (and later) misconfigurations share the same exploitable patterns. Our analysis explains how Zero Trust Architecture principles neutralize this shared attack vector. Contemporary AI risks derive directly from training and deployment conditions in ambivalent learning environments lacking adequate containment measures.
arxiv.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure. Code and replication environments available at https://github.com/alixiacf/hpim-training-lab DOI:10.5281/zenodo.22817059 and https://github.com/alixiacf/rep-openai-artifactory DOI:10.5281/zenodo.22817059
arxiv.titleZh: 从训练到提权:AI Agent 中由 RL/RLHF 诱发的权限提升的取证分析与本地复现(CVE-2026-65616)
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 2026 年中关于前沿 LLM Agent 通过涌现协作与云基础设施攻击逃出服务器隔离的报道，在容器化环境中复现了 Highly Persistent Internal Model(HPIM)训练案例配置，以及 OpenAI ExploitGym 评估中针对内部包仓库的 Phase One 权限提升过程。在隔离的仓库服务器上重现了 CVE-2026-65616 这一密码学验证绕过漏洞:配置不当的系统允许仅用基本 HTTP 请求、Python 与 JavaScript 伪造令牌并完成提权。取证分析指出，训练示例条件与 Phase One 及后续阶段的错误配置共享同一可利用模式，并说明零信任架构原则如何消除该攻击向量。结论是当代 AI 风险直接来自缺乏足够隔离措施的环境中的训练与部署条件，复现代码与环境已公开。
arxiv.reason: Agent 训练环境隔离与漏洞复现，擦边 Agentic RL，分量有限

arxiv.title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
arxiv.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents' research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents' subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges, we introduce SwarmRSI, a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. We devise Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation to refine hypotheses and their implementations using experimental feedback from other agents. We also propose Complementary Swarm Recombination to reuse retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents, allowing partial results to support new research. Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both mechanisms into a feedback loop, using new experimental evidence to guide subsequent research. Experiments on OpenProblems, NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite demonstrate SwarmRSI's state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Further evaluations show that accumulated research experience improves performance on held-out tasks. Biologists also reproduce its programs for follow-up biological analyses.
arxiv.titleZh: SwarmRSI：通过进化的科学智能体集群实现递归自我改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 科研场景的递归自我改进要求智能体从自身实验经验中提升研究能力，但实验结果不佳时难以判断该修改假设还是其实现，而程序整体得分又会掩盖可被其他智能体复用的组件。SwarmRSI 提出反馈引导的集群变异（依据其他智能体的实验反馈精修假设与实现）与互补集群重组（跨智能体复用保留假设和互补程序组件），并用递归集群进化把两者串成以新实验证据驱动的反馈闭环。在 OpenProblems、NatureBench 与 MLE-Bench Lite 上取得 SOTA，积累的研究经验还能提升留出任务表现，生物学家已复现其程序用于后续生物学分析。
arxiv.reason: 科学智能体集群＋递归自我改进，直击 Agent 与 AI for Research 方向

arxiv.title: Continual Learning for Reliable In-Sequence Molecular Communication
arxiv.abstract: This paper considers reliable in-sequence molecular communication, where bio-nanomachines exchange molecule-encoded information in a specified order, and investigates a new simulation-based method to incrementally evaluate communication protocols by gradually increasing the complexity of experimental settings. The proposed method, called Affine Memory Replay (AMR), builds a continual learning (CL) model to estimate communication performance between bio-nanomachines. AMR stores past simulation samples and synthesizes additional replay samples through interpolation and extrapolation between past samples. Through incremental performance estimation tasks, it replays both past and synthetic samples to regularize model updates, helping the model adapt to new experimental settings while retaining knowledge from earlier ones. Experimental results show that AMR significantly outperforms existing CL methods in maintaining overall estimation accuracy across sequentially learned estimation tasks. It effectively balances memory stability and learning plasticity under moderate training cost.
arxiv.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Published in 2026 20th IIAI International Congress on Advanced Applied Informatics
arxiv.titleZh: 面向可靠序列内分子通信的持续学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对生物纳米机器按指定顺序交换分子编码信息的序列内分子通信，提出基于仿真的增量评估方法 Affine Memory Replay(AMR)，用于估计纳米机器间的通信性能。AMR 保存历史仿真样本，并通过历史样本之间的插值与外推合成额外回放样本，在模型更新时同时回放真实与合成样本以施加正则，使模型适应新的实验设置同时保留旧设置下的知识。实验表明，在顺序学习的多个估计任务上，AMR 的整体估计精度显著优于已有持续学习方法，并在中等训练开销下平衡了记忆稳定性与学习可塑性。
arxiv.reason: 分子通信垂直场景的持续学习应用，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Analyzing performance of Retrieval Augmented Generation models for Question Answering Tasks
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models have become almost a cornerstone of open-domain question answering tasks; in which the quality of answers generated in the process, greatly relies on the effectiveness of retrieval mechanisms. In the realm of LLM, the last two years have seen tremendous progress in RAG architectures, with many models reporting to have improved performance through various design innovations. The cultural question and answering systems of South Asia, in particular, present a specific challenge since the region is home to the vast number of languages and traditions, which are closely interrelated. Along with these deeply intertwined historical narratives increase the need for culturally grounded and context-aware interpretation. Despite major architectural advances in LLMs, claiming significant improvements, challenges remain when answering these region specific questions in native languages. In this study, we aim to extract high-performing factors to guide the development of optimized hybrid RAG systems. We further explore whether the integration of RAG changes performance differently for culturally grounded and non-cultural questions in a South Asian multilingual setup, and whether RAG produces a higher overall percentage of correct answers than contexted answering. We also examine how LLM performance changes when RAG methods are integrated into the question-answering pipeline in comparison with non-contexted and contexted answering and, evaluate whether the introduction of RAG benefits popular or non-popular culturally grounded questions more. Not only does our work evaluate the current methods but also carves a path for future designs of more accurate and efficient question-answering pipelines.
arxiv.titleZh: 分析检索增强生成模型在问答任务中的性能
arxiv.summaryZh: 开放域问答中答案质量高度依赖检索机制，而南亚多语言、文化交织的问答场景对文化语境感知提出了更高要求。该工作系统对比无上下文、有上下文与检索增强三种问答流程，并考察 RAG 对文化类与非文化类问题、热门与冷门文化问题的差异化收益，进而提炼高性能混合 RAG 系统的设计要素。研究面向南亚多语言设定，为更准确高效的问答流水线设计提供实证依据。
arxiv.reason: RAG 问答评测属关注方向，但偏区域文化场景的实证分析，增量有限

arxiv.title: OrionMoE-v1.0: A Mixture-of-Experts Foundation Model for Tabular In-Context Learning
arxiv.abstract: Tabular foundation models enable in-context learning by predicting unseen observations from a labeled support table without task-specific parameter updates. Despite recent advances, most existing approaches rely on dense architectures that apply the same transformations across features and datasets. We introduce OrionMoE-Small, a compact tabular foundation model that combines distribution-aware representations with dataset-conditioned sparse mixture-of-experts computation. Built on a dual-axis Transformer architecture, OrionMoE-Small selectively activates experts along the feature axis, with routing decisions informed by both individual feature representations and the broader dataset context. This design enables adaptive allocation of computation across heterogeneous tabular problems while retaining a shared computational pathway across tasks. OrionMoE-Small is pretrained entirely on synthetic classification tasks generated from a structured causal prior and performs downstream prediction without gradient-based adaptation. Experiments across multiple tabular benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance against substantially larger foundation models, with particularly strong results on small-context and high-dimensional datasets. Further analysis reveals favorable relative performance under class imbalance and highlights the importance of feature composition.
arxiv.titleZh: OrionMoE-v1.0：面向表格上下文学习的混合专家基础模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习从标注支持表预测未见样本，无需任务特定参数更新，但现有方法多依赖密集架构，对所有特征和数据集应用相同变换。OrionMoE-Small结合分布感知表示与数据集条件稀疏混合专家计算，基于双轴Transformer沿特征轴选择性激活专家，路由决策由单个特征表示和数据集上下文共同决定。该模型完全在合成分类任务上预训练，下游预测无需梯度适应；多个表格基准上，与规模大得多的基础模型相比表现有竞争力，尤其在小上下文和高维数据集上结果突出，类别不平衡下相对性能也较好。
arxiv.reason: MoE用于表格基础模型，与LLM架构擦边，非核心方向

arxiv.title: From Unreliable to Usable: Decomposing Failure Modes and Confidence Signals in LLM Entity Extraction - Evidence from Cyber Threat Intelligence
arxiv.abstract: Audits of large language model (LLM) extraction from full-length documents report severe unreliability, leaving two questions open: what the failures actually consist of, and whether confidence signals can turn unreliable output into usable output. We run a preregistered, fully frozen evaluation of two new-generation low-cost LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash) with a flagship-tier control (GPT-6.1-Sol) on a public corpus of 354 incident campaigns (315 unique reports, 630 model-report evaluations), scoring extraction quality against gold, confidence calibration, and robustness to single-sentence perturbations. Three findings emerge. (1) Unreliability persists across tiers: micro precision is 0.03-0.34 and verbalized calibration error (ECE) 0.53-0.94 across both splits; the gap does not close at the flagship tier. (2) The dominant failure is not hallucination: a full mention census plus a three-tier annotation of 360 sampled candidates (two independent LLM annotators from vendors outside the evaluated set, Cohen's kappa = 0.79 on the preregistered acceptance line, fully disclosed) back-projects to 65.6% background mentions and 19.9% gold-scope gaps, with only 1.2% unsupported candidates. (3) Confidence ranks but does not verify: zero-cost self-consistency-frequency tiering passes a preregistered top-30% precision-gain bar in all six test-split model-type cells (4/6 on train), the zero-cost text-frequency x SC frequency combination wins 3, ties 2, loses 1 across cells, yet relation-level counterfactuals on all 45 targets show that a single misattribution sentence flips high-confidence judgments in 95.6-100% of cases, and even a background sentence explicitly marked as unrelated still binds a fake vulnerability in up to 26.7% of them. We conclude with a deployment boundary: confidence tiering may set review priorities, never truth.
arxiv.comment: 13 pages: 7-page main text within the 8-page limit, plus Limitations, references, and appendices A-J. Code, protocol, and frozen evaluation data will be made public
arxiv.titleZh: 从不可靠到可用:拆解 LLM 实体抽取中的失败模式与置信信号——来自网络威胁情报的证据
arxiv.summaryZh: 对低成本与旗舰两档 LLM 从整篇文档做实体抽取的可靠性审计，在 354 个事件 campaign、630 次模型-报告评测上同时考察抽取质量、置信校准与单句扰动鲁棒性。结果显示微精度仅 0.03-0.34，言语化校准误差 0.53-0.94，且旗舰档并未缩小差距;主要失败不是幻觉，背景提及占 65.6%、金标范围缺口 19.9%，真正无支撑候选只有 1.2%。零成本的自洽频率分层在全部六个测试单元通过预注册的精确率提升门槛，但单句错误归因可在 95.6%-100% 情况下翻转高置信判断，故置信分层只能用于排定复核优先级，不能当作真值。
arxiv.reason: 评估可靠性与置信校准研究，属评测方法学，但任务偏垂直领域

arxiv.title: Tracking a Small Set of Experts in Online Convex Optimization
arxiv.abstract: For the fundamental problem of prediction from expert advice, Freund asked whether one could compete with a comparator that switches $k$ times among only $m$ experts. For a discrete set of experts, this problem was resolved by Bousquet and Warmuth (2020), who gave an efficient algorithm with optimal regret matching the information-theoretic limit. We study the analogous problem in online convex optimization, where the action space is continuous. An inefficient algorithm can be derived by discretizing the action space and applying the Bousquet--Warmuth algorithm, giving regret of $\widetilde{O}(md+k)$, while the best known efficient algorithm for this problem has regret $\widetilde{O}(dk)$. We show that this computational inefficiency is inherent, establishing a separation between the information-theoretic and polynomial-time regret achievable for this problem. Specifically, under the hypergraphic planted-clique conjecture, we show that for every polynomial-time algorithm there exist instances for which it incurs at least $(k\sqrt d)^{1-o(1)}$ regret.
arxiv.titleZh: 在线凸优化中追踪一小组专家
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Freund 提出的能否与「只在 m 个专家中切换 k 次」的比较器竞争这一问题，离散专家集情形已由 Bousquet 与 Warmuth(2020)以匹配信息论下界的最优遗憾解决。本文把该问题推广到动作空间连续的在线凸优化:离散化动作空间再套用现有算法可得 Õ(md+k) 遗憾，而已知高效算法只能达到 Õ(dk);作者证明这种计算低效是固有的，在 hypergraphic planted-clique 猜想下，任何多项式时间算法都存在遗憾至少 (k√d)^{1−o(1)} 的实例。结果给出了该问题信息论最优与多项式时间可达遗憾之间的分离。
arxiv.reason: 纯在线学习遗憾下界理论，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: One Size Does Not Fit All: Curvature-Aware Adaptive Perturbation for SAM
arxiv.abstract: Poor generalisation in deep neural networks is frequently associated with convergence to sharp minima. Sharpness-Aware Minimisation (SAM) improves generalisation of deep neural networks by minimising a combination of the training loss and the local sharpness of the loss landscape, biasing convergence towards flat minima. However, SAM relies on a fixed perturbation radius $ρ$ that ignores local curvature, leading to inefficient behaviour: the perturbation may be too small to escape poor basins defined by sharp local minima, or too large to allow convergence to solutions with good loss-sharpness tradeoff. We reinterpret $ρ$ as the intensity of the perturbation signal and propose Curvature-Aware Adaptive Perturbation for SAM (CAP-SAM), a geometry-aware method that modulates the perturbation radius based on a sharpness ratio, enabling a more effective search for robust minima on the loss landscape. We prove that CAP-SAM preserves the same convergence rate as standard SAM in non-convex stochastic settings. Extensive experiments indicate that our approach consistently outperforms SAM and its most prominent variants across diverse network architectures on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet.
arxiv.titleZh: 一刀切并不适用:面向 SAM 的曲率感知自适应扰动
arxiv.summaryZh: SAM 通过最小化训练损失与局部锐度之和来偏向平坦极小值，但其扰动半径 ρ 固定不变、忽略局部曲率，往往要么过小无法逃离尖锐极小值盆地，要么过大难以收敛到损失-锐度权衡良好的解。作者把 ρ 重新解释为扰动信号强度，提出 CAP-SAM:依据锐度比(sharpness ratio)动态调制扰动半径，实现几何感知的极小值搜索，并证明其在非凸随机设定下保持与标准 SAM 相同的收敛率。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 上，该方法在多种网络架构下一致优于 SAM 及其主流变体。
arxiv.reason: 优化器方向擦边，但限制在视觉分类任务，与 LLM 训练关联有限

arxiv.title: When Does Momentum Help in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards?
arxiv.abstract: Momentum is a classical tool for accelerating convex optimization and a standard component of modern large language model training. Yet recent empirical work has questioned the usefulness of first-moment momentum in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We study this question through a bandit formulation of RLVR with bias-corrected exponential moving average (EMA) momentum, where the EMA coefficient $β$ controls how quickly the weights on past gradients decay. When policy gradients are evaluated exactly, we prove that increasing $β$ within a range that prevents overshoot strictly accelerates optimization. When gradients are estimated from sampled responses, a positive expected gain can be obscured by sampling fluctuations. We show that as the learning rate $η$ decreases, the expected gain with fixed $β$ vanishes faster than these fluctuations, whereas increasing $β$ to keep $η/(1-β)$ within the safe regime preserves a nonvanishing gain that eventually dominates them. Bandit simulations quantitatively validate these predictions. RLVR experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base using SGD with EMA and AdamW support our principle of choosing larger coefficients in practical LLM post-training. On Qwen2.5-32B with AdamW, simply increasing $β_1$ improves mean validation accuracy by nearly $2$ percentage points over the conventional choice, demonstrating the principle's effectiveness at a larger model scale.
arxiv.titleZh: 动量在可验证奖励强化学习中何时有用？
arxiv.summaryZh: 近期实证工作质疑一阶动量在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中是否有效。该工作以带偏差校正 EMA 动量的 bandit 形式化 RLVR，β 控制历史梯度权重衰减速度：精确策略梯度下，在不过冲范围内增大 β 可严格加速优化；梯度由采样估计时，固定 β 的期望增益随学习率 η 下降比采样波动消失更快，而增大 β 使 η/(1-β) 保持在安全区间，可保留最终占优的非消失增益。Bandit 仿真定量验证了预测，Qwen3-4B-Base 上 SGD+EMA 与 AdamW 实验支持实践中选择更大动量系数；在 Qwen2.5-32B 上仅调大 β1 即使平均验证准确率提升近 2 个百分点。
arxiv.reason: RLVR 动量的理论刻画与 32B 实证，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Hyperspherical Contrastive Representations Unlock Planning and Exploration
arxiv.abstract: We develop a self-supervised reinforcement learning algorithm that learns to build towers of up to eight cubes from scratch, without prior data, rewards, demonstrations, or pretrained models. Our method, Contrastive Planning via Spherical Linear Interpolation (C-Slerp), uses contrastive representations as reusable building blocks and repeatedly composes them to infer a sequence of intermediate waypoints. Under our hyperspherical parameterization, the learned representations allow intermediate waypoints to be inferred in closed form through spherical linear interpolation, without training a separate high-level policy or performing graph search. Importantly, the representation geometry also tells us how to adjust the number of waypoints based on the difficulty of each goal-reaching problem. Experiments show that our method succeeds on long-horizon navigation and robotic manipulation tasks, including settings where strong baselines fail to achieve a single success. Ablations further show that using a fixed number of waypoints substantially degrades performance, highlighting the importance of adapting the plan to task difficulty.
arxiv.titleZh: 超球对比表征解锁规划与探索
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向无先验数据的自监督强化学习，在无奖励、无示范、无预训练模型的条件下从零学会堆叠最多八块积木。方法名为 C-Slerp，把对比学习得到的表征当作可复用的积木，反复组合以推断通往目标的中间路点序列;在超球参数化下，中间路点可由球面线性插值闭式解出，无需额外训练高层策略或做图搜索。表征几何还提供了依据任务难度自适应调整路点数目的信号，消融显示固定路点数会显著掉分。在长程导航与机器人操作任务上，该方法成功了，而强基线在部分设置下零成功。
arxiv.reason: 机器人操作与导航的 RL 表征学习，属具身智能低分方向

arxiv.title: Training Language Models to Fail Gracefully
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning makes language models better at solving tasks, but the same mechanism also rewards guessing. When success is the only way to earn reward, opting for a safe fallback is always worse than a long-shot attempt. When a wrong action can corrupt a database or ship broken code, that incentive can be costly. Therefore, we propose training models to fail gracefully: to preserve successful behavior whenever possible while learning to execute a safe fallback policy when acting would be unreliable. However, naively using policy gradients with intermediate reward for fallback behavior is brittle due to unfavorable optimization dynamics. We address this challenge with GracefulRL, which reshapes the optimization landscape to promote graceful failure. Importantly, this behavior emerges directly from outcome-level reward signals, without annotations specifying when to fall back or additional inference-time machinery such as a verifier. Across a range of tasks and scales, we train models that largely preserve their task-solving capability while selectively falling back when acting would be unreliable. More broadly, our results show that reinforcement learning can not only incentivize models to succeed, but also to reason about the limits of their capabilities and change course when they determine that success is out of reach.
arxiv.titleZh: 训练语言模型优雅地失败
arxiv.summaryZh: 强化学习让语言模型更擅长解题，却也奖励了猜测:当成功是获得奖励的唯一途径时，安全回退总劣于孤注一掷，而在错误操作可能损坏数据库或提交坏代码时这种激励代价高昂。GracefulRL 通过重塑优化景观训练模型优雅失败:尽可能保留成功行为，同时在行动不可靠时执行安全回退;朴素地用策略梯度加回退中间奖励会因优化动态不利而脆弱，该方法规避了这一点。回退行为仅从结果级奖励中自发涌现，无需回退标注或 verifier 等推理期机制。多任务多规模实验中，模型基本保持任务能力并有选择地回退，表明 RL 也能让模型推理自身能力边界并及时改道。
arxiv.reason: 后训练 RL 新范式，回退行为仅靠结果级奖励涌现，方法新颖

arxiv.title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
arxiv.abstract: Context can improve large language model performance, but these gains may be lost after context removal. Inspired by biological systems consolidation, we formulate Memory Consolidation (MC) as internalizing these gains while preserving non-target capabilities, connecting context-specified editing, skill learning, and behavioral steering under a common objective. We introduce a five-task-family testbed measuring consolidation and retention under single, batch, and sequential updates. We propose Cortex, which generates prospective queries to anticipate uses of context and distills context-conditioned outputs into mergeable low-rank or structural feed-forward network updates. Across 4B--120B dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, including both text-only and multimodal models, Cortex lies on the empirical consolidation--retention Pareto frontier in most evaluated settings. After 50 sequential factual edits on a 14B model, Cortex-Structural recovers 88.9% of the context-induced gain while retaining 99.8% of original non-target performance.
arxiv.titleZh: Cortex:将上下文固化进参数化记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 上下文能提升大模型表现，但上下文一旦移除，这些增益往往随之消失。Cortex 将这一目标形式化为记忆固化，通过生成前瞻性查询预判上下文的可能用途，再把上下文条件下的输出蒸馏为可合并的低秩或结构化前馈网络更新，并配套五类任务族测试床，在单次、批量与顺序更新下同时衡量固化与保持。在 4B 至 120B 的稠密与 MoE 主干(含纯文本与多模态模型)上，Cortex 多数设置下处于固化—保持的帕累托前沿;14B 模型经 50 次顺序事实编辑后，Cortex-Structural 恢复 88.9% 的上下文增益并保留 99.8% 的原始非目标任务性能。
arxiv.reason: 上下文固化进权重的技术报告，系统性强，命中后训练与记忆方向

arxiv.title: From Human Corrections to Learned Segmentations: A Critical Mathematical Review of Information, Learning, and Human Effort
arxiv.abstract: When does a human correction become useful learning, and what establishes better segmentation at matched human effort? This critical narrative review follows feedback through its selection, learner update, and evaluation. It compares active learning, machine teaching, interactive segmentation, and sequential predictive evaluation using a common mathematical account of target information, predictive error, response predictability, and human work. An exact Bayesian update converts evaluation-label information into expected log-loss improvement; an excess-risk decomposition explains what an approximate learner can lose. Conditional information decompositions separate the roles of selected locations, labels, and displayed context. Empirical comparisons show why response protocols, update mechanisms, and effort denominators matter, distinguishing current-mask refinement from reusable learning and simulated interaction from human evidence. We identify what logs can reveal, what requires independent evaluation, and what remains model-dependent. The resulting research priorities are to test what selection reveals, whether using it improves assimilation, and whether the resulting interaction policy benefits segmentation at matched effort. These are distinct claims: predicting a teacher's responses need not identify human intentions or establish better learning. No new acquisition algorithm or empirical superiority is claimed.
arxiv.comment: 40 pages, literature-selection and search record included
arxiv.titleZh: 从人工修正到可学习的分割:对信息、学习与人类投入的批判性数学综述
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对「人工修正何时才算有用的学习信号、在相同人工投入下什么带来更好的分割」这一问题，用统一的数学框架刻画目标信息、预测误差、响应可预测性与人类工作量，比较主动学习、机器教学、交互式分割与序列预测评估。精确贝叶斯更新把评估标签信息换算为期望对数损失改进，超额风险分解刻画近似学习器的损失，条件信息分解则区分所选位置、标签与展示上下文各自的作用。实证比较说明响应协议、更新机制与工作量分母会如何改变结论，并区分当前掩码细化与可复用学习、模拟交互与真人证据。由此提出三类可分别检验的主张:选择揭示了什么、使用它是否改善同化、以及交互策略在等量投入下是否提升分割。
arxiv.reason: 交互式分割与主动学习综述，仅与 LLM 数据选择擦边
